name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Strikes kill 3 in Ukraine 13 Nov; talks go on
summary: Russian strikes killed at least 3 across Ukraine on 13 Nov; Ukraine hit Volgograd refinery as US-brokered talks continue
state: Russian strikes on 13 Nov killed two people in Odesa and one in Zaporizhzhia region and injured more than 20, including seven in Kharkiv region (Euronews, citing local officials). Overnight on 12–13 Nov Ukrainian drones set the Volgograd refinery on fire; the regional governor said four people were killed (Kyiv Independent). The IAEA said a drone killed a Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant worker on 9 Nov, a day after the plant lost off-site power for about 10 hours (Kyiv Independent). Talks in Abu Dhabi produced a prisoner-swap deal but no ceasefire, so the Alert stays.
for_you: Civilians in Ukrainian cities face continuing drone and missile strikes and power cuts. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Ukraine. Fuel and power markets remain sensitive to strikes on energy sites in both countries.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass strikes on cities and energy sites, and a fatal drone strike at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant on 9 Nov (nuclear-plant safety incident)
